top_signals.title: Buffett Steps Down as Berkshire Chair, Ending Six-Decade Run
top_signals.summary:
Berkshire Hathaway Inc. founder Warren Buffett is stepping down as the company’s chairman to be replaced by his son Howard, effectively ending roughly six decades at the helm of the conglomerate. 
Bloomberg Intelligence Senior P&C Insurance Analyst Matt Palazola discusses the move and Buffett's legacy with the company. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: FTSE Russell Flags Energy Risks
top_signals.summary: FTSE Russell’s Indrani De says resilient earnings and AI-driven investment continue to support markets, but investors are becoming more selective. She says capital is increasingly balancing growth exposure with investment-grade debt, while rising refining constraints and energy costs remain key risks heading into winter. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
